name: Redesignee – Cloud Widgets for Elementor & Gutenberg
author: redesignee

sections.description:
Stop installing heavy plugin packs for just one widget.

Redesignee is the first Cloud-Based Component Library for WordPress. Unlike traditional Elementor Addons or Gutenberg block plugins that load huge CSS files for features you don’t use, Redesignee injects only the code required for the specific widget you choose.

Browse a growing library of premium designs, customize them visually, and import them instantly. It’s the perfect solution for developers and designers who care about Core Web Vitals and PageSpeed.

See the Live Library & Demo

🚀 Why Choose Redesignee?

  • Zero Bloat: We don’t load 50+ unused widgets. If you pick one slider, you only load code for that one slider.
  • Dual Compatibility: Works natively in Elementor (as a widget) and Gutenberg / Block Editor (as a block).
  • Visual Customizer: Edit colors, fonts, text, and images in a live preview before importing.
  • Developer Friendly: Generates clean HTML/CSS that is easy to customize or override.

📦 Included Widgets & Templates

We add new components weekly without you needing to update the plugin.

INTERACTIVE SLIDERS & CAROUSELS
* Hero Slider: Full-width hero sections with animated text and calls to action.
* Logo Carousel: Infinite looping ticker for partner or client logos.
* Testimonial Slider: Draggable review cards with star ratings and avatars.
* Card Carousel: Responsive post-style cards for features, services, or team members.
* Video Slider: Carousel capabilities for YouTube and Vimeo embeds.

MARKETING & CONVERSION
* Pricing Tables: Responsive pricing cards with “Monthly/Yearly” toggles and “Best Value” badges.
* Comparison Tables: Detailed feature comparison grids.
* Call to Action (CTA): High-converting banners and buttons.
* Countdown Timers: Urgency timers for sales and events (Coming Soon).

CONTENT BLOCKS
* Accordions: SEO-friendly vertical toggles perfect for FAQs.
* Tabs: Horizontal and vertical content switchers.
* Feature Grids: Icon boxes and info cards in responsive layouts.
* Mega Menus: Mobile-responsive navigation menus (Works with Fluid Engine & 7.1).
* Team Members: Profile cards with social media links and hover effects.

✨ Features

  • Copy & Paste Workflow: Browse the cloud library, click “Import,” and you’re done.
  • Smart Asset Loading: Assets are loaded dynamically only on pages where widgets exist.
  • White Label Ready: The output is standard HTML/CSS, making it look native to your theme.
  • Global Fonts & Colors: Inherits your theme styles automatically where possible.

3rd Party Service Disclaimer

This plugin relies on the Redesignee cloud service to function. It connects to the Redesignee API to fetch widget templates, library data, and assets.

  • This service is required to browse and import widgets.
  • An API Key (Free or Premium) is used to authenticate your request.
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/redesignee directory, or search for “Redesignee” in the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Redesignee Settings in your dashboard (optional: enter API key for premium items).
  4. For Elementor: Search for the “Redesignee” widget in the Elementor sidebar.
  5. For Gutenberg: Click the “+” button and search for the “Redesignee” block.
sections.faq:
Is this an Elementor Addon or a Gutenberg Block?

It is both! The plugin detects which editor you are using and provides the native experience for that environment. You can use it on a site that uses Elementor for some pages and Gutenberg for others.

Will this slow down my website?

No. This is the main reason we built Redesignee. Unlike “Ultimate Addons” packs that load huge CSS libraries globally, Redesignee only loads the tiny CSS snippet for the specific widget you import. It is optimized for Google PageSpeed Insights.

Are there free widgets available?

Yes! We offer a generous selection of free widgets, including sliders, testimonials, and pricing tables. You do not need a credit card to use the free library.

Can I use this on client sites?

Absolutely. The output is standard HTML/CSS. If you have a Premium account, our commercial license covers client work.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

Your widgets will remain on the page as standard HTML, but you will lose the ability to edit them visually or import new ones. The CSS/JS assets may also stop loading depending on your setup.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fix: Resolved an issue where Rich Text content (bold, lists, links) would sometimes appear empty in the editor.
  • Fix: Fixed a bug where custom CSS modifications would revert to defaults when editing an existing widget.
  • Fix: Improved state management to prevent overwriting manual code edits during the save process.
  • Improvement: Enhanced visual editor stability for complex nested elements.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added support for Elementor and Gutenberg.
  • Launched Cloud Library connection.

Visual Editor: Customize content like pricing, text, and buttons instantly using our intuitive visual interface.
Elementor Integration: Drag and drop the Redesignee widget from the Elementor sidebar just like any native element.
